mandukya_chapter4_verse2.title: Mandukya Chapter 4 Verse 2
mandukya_chapter4_verse2.introduction: This verse belongs to Mandukya, Chapter 4.
mandukya_chapter4_verse2.scripture_text: A representative contemplative passage from the Mandukya Upanishad, Chapter 4, Verse 2, reflecting the inquiry into Atman, Brahman, and liberation through self-knowledge.
mandukya_chapter4_verse2.philosophical_explanation: This verse extends the contemplative teaching tradition of the Upanishads toward self-knowledge and liberation.
